title_ja: 40歳以上女性における卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う悪性腫瘍の臨床病理学的・分子的解析
summary_ja: 40歳以上女性における卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う悪性腫瘍の臨床病理学的・分子的解析。
summary_en: Clinicopathologic and molecular analysis of yolk sac tumors in older women.

title: Using Statistical Learning to Investigate the Characteristics that Contribute to Extended Hospital Stays After Testicular Cancer Surgery.
title_ja: 統計学的機械学習を用いた精巣癌手術後の入院期間延長に関連する因子の検討
summary_ja: 統計学的機械学習による精巣癌手術後の入院期間延長要因の検討。
summary_en: Application of statistical learning to identify factors associated with extended hospital stays after testicular cancer surgery.

title: Bilateral malignant struma ovarii with concurrent thyroid carcinoma.
title_ja: 甲状腺癌を合併した両側悪性卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 甲状腺癌を合併した両側悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告。
summary_en: A case report of bilateral malignant struma ovarii with concurrent thyroid carcinoma.

title: Thrombosis of a Teratoma: An Unusual Complication of a Usually Benign Tumor.
title_ja: 奇形腫の血栓症:通常は良性な腫瘍の稀な合併症
summary_ja: 22歳男性の縦隔奇形腫に右房内血栓と両側肺塞栓を合併した症例報告。経皮的血栓除去技術により手術リスクを低減し、安全な腫瘍切除を実施した。良性とされる奇形腫でも重篤な血管合併症を来しうることを示し、多職種による周術期管理の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with an anterior mediastinal teratoma complicated by a right atrial thrombus-in-transit and bilateral pulmonary emboli. Percutaneous techniques reduced perioperative surgical risk, enabling safe resection of the mediastinal mass. The case illustrates a rare vascular complication of an otherwise benign germ cell tumor and highlights multidisciplinary management strategies for perioperative thromboembolic events associated with teratoma resection.

title: Outcomes in gestational and non-gestational choriocarcinoma: A retrospective cohort study with nomograms and web tools.
title_ja: 妊娠性および非妊娠性絨毛癌の転帰:ノモグラムおよびウェブツールを用いた後ろ向きコホート研究
summary_ja: SEERデータベースを用い妊娠性絨毛癌(GCC)と胚細胞腫瘍である非妊娠性絨毛癌(NGCC)の予後を比較したコホート研究。NGCCはより進行した病期・不良な予後を示し、化学療法が有効だった一方GCCでは効果が限定的だった。5年生存予測ノモグラムとWebツールを開発し個別化治療への応用を提案している。
summary_en: This SEER-based retrospective cohort study compared gestational (GCC, n=719) and non-gestational choriocarcinoma (NGCC, n=200), finding NGCC patients were older, had more advanced disease, and worse survival. Chemotherapy improved survival in NGCC but had limited benefit in GCC, while radiotherapy was associated with worse outcomes. The authors developed and validated a nomogram and web-based tool for predicting 5-year survival to guide personalized treatment.

title: Primary intracranial immature teratoma in an adult woman: case report and literature review.
title_ja: 成人女性の原発性頭蓋内未熟奇形腫:症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 48歳女性の頭頂葉原発未熟奇形腫の症例報告。画像上グリオーマと誤診されたが、術後病理で奇形腫と確定した。放射線治療後に再発し再手術を施行。CT・MRIでの脂肪成分・石灰化・混在信号・壁在結節などの特徴的所見を示し、頭蓋内奇形腫の鑑別診断と早期正確な診断の重要性を論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old woman with a rare primary immature teratoma of the parietal lobe, initially misdiagnosed as glioma on imaging. Surgical resection with histopathology confirmed the diagnosis; she received radiotherapy and underwent repeat resection for recurrence. The authors detail characteristic CT/MRI features (fat, calcification, mixed signal, mural nodule) to aid differentiation from glioma and improve diagnostic accuracy for intracranial teratomas.

title: Folate transfer in placental choriocarcinoma cells treated with valproic acid: Insights gained through comparisons with the amide derivative sec-butylpropylacetamide and its individual stereoisomers.
title_ja: バルプロ酸処理された胎盤絨毛癌細胞における葉酸転送：アミド誘導体および個々の立体異性体との比較を通じた知見
summary_ja: 胎盤絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株をモデルとして、バルプロ酸とその誘導体SPDが葉酸輸送体発現と経胎盤葉酸輸送に与える影響を検討した薬理学研究。輸送体発現の変化だけでは葉酸輸送動態を十分に説明できないことが示された。抗てんかん薬の催奇形性リスク評価を目的とし、胚細胞腫瘍そのものを対象とした研究ではない。
summary_en: This pharmacology study used the BeWo placental choriocarcinoma cell line as an in vitro model to examine how valproic acid and its amide derivative SPD alter folate transporter expression (FOLR1, SLC19A1, ABCG2) and transplacental folate transfer. Findings suggest transporter expression changes do not fully predict folate transfer kinetics, informing future teratogenicity risk assessment of antiseizure medications. The focus is placental drug transport, not germ cell tumor biology.

title: Rapid Progression of Molar Pregnancy to Choriocarcinoma With Pulmonary Metastases.
title_ja: 肺転移を伴う胞状奇胎から絨毛癌への急速な進行
summary_ja: 31歳女性の全胞状奇胎が急速に肺転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛癌へ進展した症例報告。著しいhCG上昇を認めEMA/CO療法と子宮摘出術により完全奏効を得た。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の急激な進行例を示すが、胚細胞腫瘍ではなく妊娠性絨毛性疾患を扱った内容である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman whose complete molar pregnancy rapidly progressed to gestational choriocarcinoma with pulmonary metastases and extremely elevated hCG, treated with EMA/CO chemotherapy and hysterectomy achieving complete response. It highlights the aggressive potential of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia after molar pregnancy and the need for further research into high-risk disease trajectories, but addresses gestational trophoblastic disease rather than germ cell tumors.

title: Effects of ovarian cyst types on ovarian reserve after three-dimensional laparoscopic cystectomy.
title_ja: 三次元腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢腫摘出後の卵巣予備能に対する卵巣嚢腫タイプの影響
summary_ja: 51例を対象に、子宮内膜症性嚢胞、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)、漿液性/粘液性嚢胞腺腫における腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術後の卵巣予備能(AMH・FSH)を比較検討した研究。奇形腫群・子宮内膜症群ともに術後AMHが有意に低下し、特に子宮内膜症群で低下が顕著だった。奇形腫手術における卵巣予備能温存の重要性を示唆する。
summary_en: This study compared ovarian reserve (AMH, FSH) before and after 3D laparoscopic cystectomy across endometriomas, mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts), and serous/mucinous cystadenomas in 51 women. Both endometrioma and dermoid cyst excision significantly reduced postoperative AMH levels, with a more pronounced decline for endometriomas, while cystadenoma removal showed no significant effect. Findings inform counseling on fertility-preserving surgical approaches for ovarian teratoma.

title: Atypical placental site nodules: Five cases and literature review.
title_ja: 非定型胎盤着床部結節：5症例と文献レビュー
journal: Zhong Nan Da Xue Xue Bao Yi Xue Ban
summary_ja: 稀な妊娠性絨毛性病変である胎盤部異型結節(APSN)5例の臨床経過と予後を検討した症例集積・文献レビュー。既報37例のプール解析では2例が絨毛性腫瘍へ進展したが、悪性転化との因果関係は未確定。妊娠性絨毛性疾患を扱った内容であり、胚細胞腫瘍とは異なるテーマである。
summary_en: This case series and literature review examined 5 patients with atypical placental site nodules (APSN), a rare gestational trophoblastic lesion, describing clinical course, treatment (curettage/hysteroscopy), and follow-up. Pooled analysis of 37 reported cases found 2 progressed to trophoblastic tumors, though causal transformation remains unproven. The study concerns gestational trophoblastic disease rather than germ cell tumors.

title: Testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣癌
summary_ja: 精巣癌、特にその95%を占める精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関する包括的総説。疫学、臨床像、病期分類、セミノーマ/非セミノーマ別の病期ごとの治療方針、論争点、再発後の救済療法、経過観察までを網羅し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍診療の最新知見と今後の展望を臨床医・研究者向けに提供している。
summary_en: This Lancet Seminar provides a comprehensive review of testicular cancer, focusing on testicular germ cell tumors, which comprise about 95% of cases. It covers epidemiology, clinical presentation, staging, distinct management approaches for seminoma versus non-seminoma across clinical stages, controversies, salvage therapy after relapse, and follow-up strategies, offering clinicians an up-to-date synthesis of current evidence and future directions in testicular GCT care.

title: Neuroendocrine Tumor as a Somatic-Type Malignancy in Metastatic Teratoma.
title_ja: 転移性奇形腫における体細胞型悪性腫瘍としての神経内分泌腫瘍
summary_ja: 25歳男性の転移性奇形腫内に体細胞型悪性腫瘍として高悪性度神経内分泌腫瘍が発生した稀な症例報告。思春期後型非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の奇形腫から非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍が生じる現象はまれであり、特に神経内分泌腫瘍としての発生は極めて稀。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の正確な診断・管理における認識の重要性を強調する。
summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with a high-grade neuroendocrine tumor arising as a somatic-type malignancy within a metastatic teratoma, an extremely rare transformation of a postpubertal-type nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. The authors highlight that non-germ cell malignancies, though rarely neuroendocrine, can arise within teratomas, underscoring the importance of recognizing this phenomenon for accurate diagnosis and management of metastatic germ cell tumor patients.

title: MicroRNA-371-373 cluster extracellular vesicle-based communication in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における細胞外小胞媒介マイクロRNA-371-373クラスター通信
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)由来の細胞外小胞(EV)を細胞株・組織・血漿検体から単離し、miR-371-373クラスターとlet-7eの発現を検討した研究。奇形腫を除くTGCT検体でEV由来miR-371-373が上昇し、分化に伴い発現が変化した。臨床バイオマーカーとして用いられるmiR-371-373の多くがEVを介して分泌され、腫瘍細胞間コミュニケーションに関与することが示唆された。
summary_en: This study characterized extracellular vesicles (EVs) from testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) cell lines, tissue, and patient plasma, examining miR-371-373 cluster and let-7e expression. EV-derived miR-371-373 was elevated in TGCT samples except teratoma, and levels changed with differentiation. The findings suggest circulating miR-371-373 used clinically as a TGCT biomarker is largely EV-secreted, implicating these microRNAs in intercellular communication and differentiation of germ cell tumors.

title: Outcomes and cost-effectiveness of vNOTES vs conventional laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy for ovarian teratoma (dermoid cysts): A comparison of two minimal access routes of surgery.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）に対するvNOTES対従来型腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術：2つの最小侵襲手術経路の比較
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)に対するvNOTESと従来の腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術(各21例)を比較した症例対照研究。vNOTES群で手術時間・在院時間の短縮、疼痛軽減、オピオイド使用減少、活動再開の早さ、腹腔内漏出の少なさ、費用削減が認められた。vNOTESが卵巣奇形腫手術の有用な低侵襲代替法であると結論している。
summary_en: This case-control study compared vNOTES with conventional laparoscopic cystectomy for ovarian teratoma (dermoid cysts) in 21 patients per group. vNOTES showed shorter operative time, shorter hospital stay, lower pain scores, less opioid use, faster return to activity, less intraperitoneal spillage, and lower cost than laparoscopy. The authors conclude vNOTES is a viable, cost-effective minimally invasive alternative for surgical management of ovarian teratoma.

title: Clinicopathological and imaging features of struma ovarii: a retrospective study.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の臨床病理および画像特性：後向き研究
summary_ja: 単胚葉性奇形腫の一種である卵巣性甲状腺腫(struma ovarii)40例を対象に、臨床病理および超音波・造影超音波・MRIによる多モダリティ画像所見を検討した後方視的研究。純粋型・混合型に分類し3例の悪性例(甲状腺カルチノイド)を認めた。嚢胞性・充実嚢胞混合性・充実性の画像パターンと特徴的所見を示し、稀な奇形腫亜型の診断に資する。
summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed clinicopathological and multimodal imaging features (ultrasound, CEUS, MRI) of struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma, in 40 patients from a single center. Tumors were classified as pure or mixed struma ovarii, with three malignant cases (thyroid carcinoid); imaging patterns included cystic, cystic-solid, and solid types with characteristic enhancement and MRI signal features to aid diagnosis of this rare teratoma variant.

title: A familial case of VACTERL association with co-occurring sacrococcygeal teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫を伴うVACTERL連合の家族性症例：症例報告
summary_ja: VACTERL連合の家族内発症例(男児)を報告した症例報告で、稀な合併症として仙尾部奇形腫を伴っていた。母方叔母にも同様の特徴があり乳児期に死亡していた。出生前の詳細な形態スキャンや遺伝学的検査による早期診断が管理方針決定に有用であるとし、稀な胚細胞腫瘍を含む先天異常の理解に寄与する。
summary_en: This case report describes a familial occurrence of VACTERL association in a male infant, notable for a rare co-occurring sacrococcygeal teratoma, alongside a maternal aunt with similar features who died in infancy. The authors emphasize that prenatal detection via detailed anomaly scans and genetic sequencing could improve early diagnosis and management counseling for families with VACTERL-associated congenital anomalies, including this rare germ cell tumor.

title: Concurrent Diagnosis and Management of Primary Mediastinal Germ Cell Tumor and Klinefelter Syndrome.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍とクラインフェルター症候群の同時診断と管理
summary_ja: 22歳男性における縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(PMNSGCT)とクラインフェルター症候群の合併例。VIP療法後の手術切除で病理学的完全奏効が得られ追加化学療法は不要となり、性腺機能低下症にはテストステロン補充療法を実施した。PMNSGCTとクラインフェルター症候群の関連について文献的考察を行っている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man diagnosed with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (PMNSGCT) concurrently with Klinefelter syndrome. He was treated with VIP chemotherapy achieving complete pathologic response after surgical resection, avoiding adjuvant therapy, plus testosterone replacement for hypogonadism. The authors discuss the underrecognized association between PMNSGCT and Klinefelter syndrome and review evaluation and management approaches for this rare germ cell tumor presentation.

title: Clinical and Imaging Characteristics of Non-Gestational Ovarian Choriocarcinoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 非妊娠関連卵巣絨毛癌の臨床および画像特性：症例報告
summary_ja: 10歳の思春期前女児に発生した非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌(NGOC)の症例報告と文献レビュー。腹痛・性器出血とhCGの著明高値を認め、画像で大きな不均一多血性付属器腫瘤を確認、病理学的にNGOCと診断された。性交渉のない若年女性でのhCG著明高値と付属器腫瘤はこの稀な卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を疑うべきと強調している。
summary_en: This case report and literature review describe a 10-year-old prepubertal girl with non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma (NGOC), presenting with abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, and markedly elevated hCG. Imaging showed a large heterogeneous hypervascular adnexal mass; surgical pathology confirmed NGOC with characteristic immunohistochemistry. The authors emphasize that markedly elevated hCG with adnexal mass in a sexually inactive young female should raise suspicion for this rare, aggressive ovarian germ cell tumor.

title: Usefulness of apparent diffusion coefficient values and magnetic resonance imaging histogram analysis for identifying histological types of preoperative testicular tumors.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の組織学的タイプを同定するための見かけ拡散係数値および磁気共鳴画像ヒストグラム解析の有用性
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍65例を対象に、MRIの見かけの拡散係数(ADC)値とヒストグラム解析による組織型(セミノーマ・非セミノーマ・悪性リンパ腫)鑑別能を検討した後方視的研究。非セミノーマはセミノーマ・リンパ腫よりADC比が有意に高く、セミノーマ・リンパ腫は尖度・歪度が高かった。術前MRIによる組織型予測が治療計画立案に有用と示唆している。
summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated whether MRI apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values and histogram analysis could differentiate testicular tumor histological subtypes (seminoma, non-seminoma, malignant lymphoma) in 65 patients. Non-seminomas showed significantly higher ADC ratios than seminomas and lymphomas, while seminomas and lymphomas exhibited higher kurtosis and skewness than non-seminomas. The findings support preoperative MRI-based subtype prediction to guide counseling and treatment planning for testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Mature hyperdense teratomas in the posterior fossa.
title_ja: 後頭窩の成熟高密度奇形腫
summary_ja: 後頭蓋窩に発生した稀な高吸収性成熟奇形腫2例(11歳男児、27歳女性)の報告。いずれも頭痛と閉塞性水頭症を呈し、CTで石灰化・脂肪・軟部組織成分を伴う高吸収腫瘤、MRIで混在信号を認めた。後頭下開頭術による摘出で成熟奇形腫と確定診断され、稀な後頭蓋窩腫瘤の鑑別診断の幅を広げる内容である。
summary_en: This report describes two rare cases of hyperdense mature teratoma in the posterior fossa, in an 11-year-old boy and a 27-year-old woman, both presenting with headache and obstructive hydrocephalus. CT showed hyperdense masses with calcification, fat, and soft tissue components; MRI showed mixed signal intensity. Both underwent suboccipital craniotomy with resection confirming mature teratoma, expanding the differential diagnosis for unusual posterior fossa masses.

title: Seminoma Caused by PDE11A Frameshift Variant with Multiple Abnormalities: A Case Report.
title_ja: PDE11A遺伝子フレームシフト変異により引き起こされた複数の異常を伴うセミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 脳形成異常や学習障害などの多発異常を伴うセミノーマ患者の症例報告。全エクソーム解析でPDE11A遺伝子のフレームシフト変異が同定され、AlphaFold3による予測ではタンパク質機能への大きな影響が示唆された。この変異が多発異常とセミノーマ発症双方の説明因子となりうるとし、精巣胚細胞腫瘍における遺伝的要因の理解に寄与する。
summary_en: This case report describes a testicular seminoma patient with multiple abnormalities (brain dysplasia, social difficulties, learning impairment) in whom exome sequencing identified a PDE11A frameshift variant, predicted by AlphaFold3 to significantly affect protein function. The authors propose this variant as a possible unifying genetic explanation for both the patient's neurodevelopmental abnormalities and seminoma development, contributing to understanding of genetic risk factors in testicular germ cell tumors.

title: First Case of Ovarian Metastases From a Primary Retroperitoneal Mucinous Carcinoma Associated With Teratoma, With KRAS and ERBB3 Mutations: Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 奇形腫に関連した原発性後腹膜粘液性癌からの卵巣転移の初症例：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来と考えられる後腹膜原発粘液性癌からの卵巣転移を来した66歳女性の症例報告。KRAS変異に加え本疾患では初となるERBB3変異が同定された。後腹膜粘液性癌が奇形腫から発生しうるという仮説を分子的に裏付けた初の報告であり、胚細胞腫瘍内での体細胞型悪性転化への新たな知見を提供する。
summary_en: This case report describes a 66-year-old woman with ovarian metastases from a primary retroperitoneal mucinous carcinoma that arose from a mature cystic teratoma, harboring a KRAS mutation and a novel ERBB3 mutation. This is the first molecularly characterized case supporting the theory that such rare retroperitoneal mucinous carcinomas can develop from teratoma, similar to their ovarian counterparts, contributing new insight into somatic malignant transformation arising within germ cell tumors.

title: Unusual Presentation of Metastatic Testicular Mixed-Germ Cell Tumor with Intracardiac Extension: A Case Report.
title_ja: 心内拡張を伴う転移性精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の異常な臨床像：症例報告
summary_ja: 23歳男性の転移性精巣混合性胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ・胎児性癌・奇形腫成分)で、下大静脈から右房への稀な心内進展を来した症例報告。肺・肝・リンパ節転移も認めたが、根治的精巣摘除術とBEP化学療法によって心内腫瘤と腫瘍マーカーが著明に縮小した。稀な転移パターンを示す精巣胚細胞腫瘍の集学的管理の有効性を示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with metastatic testicular mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma components) with rare intracardiac extension into the right atrium via the inferior vena cava, alongside pulmonary, liver, and lymph node metastases. Treatment with orchiectomy and BEP chemotherapy achieved significant reduction in cardiac mass and tumor markers, illustrating effective management of this rare metastatic presentation of testicular germ cell tumor.

title: Morphological and Immunohistochemical Support for the Origin of the Carcinoid Component in Strumal Carcinoids: A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 甲状腺様カルチノイドのカルチノイド成分の起源に対する形態学的および免疫組織化学的支持：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を背景に発生した卵巣ストルーマカルチノイドの40歳女性例。形態学的・免疫組織化学的所見(新規の単細胞増殖パターンを含む)により、カルチノイド成分が甲状腺濾胞上皮の神経内分泌分化に由来するという仮説を支持した。稀な単胚葉性奇形腫亜型の組織発生に関する新知見を提供し、正確な鑑別診断に資する。
summary_en: This case report and literature review describe a 40-year-old woman with an ovarian strumal carcinoid arising within a mature cystic teratoma. Morphological and immunohistochemical findings, including a novel single-cell growth pattern, support the hypothesis that the carcinoid component originates from thyroid follicular epithelium undergoing neuroendocrine differentiation, offering new insight into the histogenesis of this rare monodermal teratoma variant important for accurate diagnosis.

title: Multi-Observer Study on the Assessment of Pediatric Gonadal Tumors Using Higher Harmonic Generation Microscopy as Compared to Conventional Histology.
title_ja: 従来型組織学と比較した高調波発生顕微鏡を用いた小児性腺腫瘍の評価に関する複数観察者研究
summary_ja: 小児生殖腺腫瘍、特にGCTと奇形腫の診断における高次高調波生成顕微鏡の有用性評価。HHGMは腫瘍検出で75%の精度を達成し、従来の組織学の89%と比較された。
summary_en: Evaluation of higher harmonic generation microscopy (HHGM) as rapid imaging technique for assessing pediatric gonadal tumors including germ cell tumors and teratomas. HHGM achieved 75% accuracy for tumor detection versus 89% for conventional histology, showing promise for sample assessment in rare tumor population.

title: De Novo Testicular Cancers Arising After Renal Transplantation: A Narrative Review.
title_ja: 腎移植後に発生した新規精巣癌：叙述的レビュー
summary_ja: 腎移植後に発生する精巣がん（GCT）の医学的レビュー。セミノーマGCTが最も一般的。リスク3倍増加、典型的に45歳、移植後5年で診断される。化学療法が放射線療法より好まれる。
summary_en: Narrative review of testicular cancer (GCT) developing after renal transplantation. Seminomatous GCTs are most common histologic subtype. Discusses 3-fold increased risk, typical diagnosis around age 45 and 5 years post-transplant, and management challenges favoring chemotherapy over radiotherapy in immunosuppressed patients.

title: Congenital microphthalmos with orbital dermoid cyst extending to frontal sinus.
title_ja: 前頭洞に拡張する眼窩類皮嚢腫を伴う先天性眼球小
summary_ja: 新生児の眼窩から前頭洞に拡張した大きな皮様嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）の症例報告。外科的摘出と皮膚脂肪移植により良好な整容結果が得られた。
summary_en: Case report of congenital microphthalmos with large orbital dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) extending to frontal sinus in newborn. Surgical removal and orbital reconstruction with dermis-fat graft achieved good cosmetic outcome with no recurrence; rudimentary globe was enucleated.

title: Follow-Up Outcomes of Patients Presenting With Ovarian Masses in Childhood: A 15-Year Single-Center Experience.
title_ja: 小児期に卵巣腫瘤を呈する患者の追跡調査成果：15年間の単施設経験
summary_ja: 15年間の85人の小児卵巣腫瘍患者の後向き研究。GCTが67.1%で最も一般的。化学療法は32.9%に施行され、98%の生存率で治療成績良好。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 85 pediatric patients with ovarian masses over 15 years. Germ cell tumors were most common (67.1%), followed by epithelial tumors (22.4%). Chemotherapy administered to 32.9%; excellent outcomes with 98% survival rate and only one recurrence among immature teratomas.

title: Second primary cancer risks in seminoma patients treated with current and previous radiotherapy protocols: a systematic literature review.
title_ja: 現在および過去の放射線療法プロトコルで治療されたセミノーマ患者における二次原発癌リスク：系統的文献レビュー
summary_ja: セミノーマ患者における放射線療法後の二次がんリスクの系統的レビュー。膵臓、腎臓、胃、膀胱のリスク増加を記述。60年間の治療プロトコール変更（用量低減、第1期の監視療法の採用）を検討した。
summary_en: Systematic review of secondary primary cancer risks in seminoma patients treated with radiotherapy. Documents consistent excess risks for pancreas, kidney, stomach, and bladder after RT. Reviews 60-year evolution of protocols including dose reduction from 30-40 to 20-26 Gy and shift toward active surveillance for stage I, with proton therapy showing potential OAR dose reduction.

title: Mature Teratoma of Posterior Mediastinum in a Newborn: A Case Report.
title_ja: 新生児における後縦隔成熟奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 急性呼吸困難で発症した新生児の後縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例報告。CT検査で固形および嚢胞性成分を含む大きな腫瘤を確認。外科的摘出で成熟奇形腫と確定診断された。
summary_en: Case report of mature teratoma of posterior mediastinum in 9-day-old female newborn presenting with acute respiratory distress and respiratory failure. CT confirmed large mass with solid and cystic components; surgical removal confirmed mature teratoma on pathology with smooth postoperative recovery.

title: Assessment of Trophoblast Cell-Surface Antigen 2 (TROP2) and Nectin-4 Expression in Choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛癌における栄養膜細胞表面抗原2（TROP2）およびネクチン-4発現の評価
summary_ja: 絨毛癌とその他のGCTにおけるTROP2とネクチン-4発現の評価。抗体薬物複合体の治療標的としての可能性を検討。絨毛癌はコントロール群より有意に高いネクチン-4発現を示した。
summary_en: Assessment of TROP2 and nectin-4 expression in choriocarcinoma and other germ cell tumors to evaluate antibody-drug conjugate therapeutic potential. Choriocarcinomas showed significantly higher nectin-4 expression (median 60) compared to control GCT types, with 27.8% showing H-scores >200.

title: "Colon"ised by the unexpected: a case of extrauterine epithelioid trophoblastic tumour.
title_ja: 予期せぬ症例：子宮外上皮様栄養膜腫瘍の結腸転移
summary_ja: 結腸に発生した子宮外絨毛膜上皮腫瘍（GTD）の極めて珍しい症例報告。腹部痛と腫瘤で発症。組織学的および免疫組織化学的検査で診断確定されたが、手術後1か月で死亡した。
summary_en: Case report of extrauterine epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (rare gestational trophoblastic disease) arising in colon, presenting as lower abdominal pain and palpable mass in left iliac fossa. Histopathological and immunohistochemical analysis confirmed diagnosis; patient died one month after diagnosis.

title: Choriocarcinoma mimicking ectopic caesarean-scar pregnancy.
title_ja: 帝王切開瘢痕部異所妊娠に模倣した絨毛癌
summary_ja: 帝王切開瘢痕異所妊娠として初期治療された絨毛癌（GTD）の症例報告。膣出血で初期妊娠期に発症。病理学的検査で絨毛癌と確定診断された。
summary_en: Case report of gestational trophoblastic disease (choriocarcinoma) presenting as cesarean-scar ectopic pregnancy with vaginal bleeding in early pregnancy. Initially managed as ectopic pregnancy; histology confirmed choriocarcinoma. Highlights importance of excluding GTD in early pregnancy bleeding evaluation.

title: Evaluation of Testicular Nonseminomatous Germ Cell Tumor Using Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasound.
title_ja: 造影超音波を用いた精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の評価
summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマGCTの対比強化超音波（CEUS）による診断の有用性を示す症例報告。CEUSは腫瘤の灌流パターンをリアルタイムで観察し、良性と悪性の鑑別に有用である。
summary_en: Case report demonstrating utility of contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) in diagnosing testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. CEUS provides superior real-time perfusion characterization of testicular masses, aiding differentiation between benign and malignant neoplasms beyond conventional ultrasound.

title: Review of Relapse Detection Methods in Stage 1 Testicular Germ Cell Tumors in Patients After Orchidectomy Managed With Active Surveillance: Is Physical Examination Required?
title_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後の積極的経過観察で管理される第I期精巣胚細胞腫瘍における再発検出方法の検討：身体診察は必要か？
summary_ja: 高位精巣摘出後に能動的監視で管理された第1期精巣GCTにおける再発検出方法の系統的レビュー。11,414人中2,232の再発のうち、60%は画像検査、24%は腫瘍マーカーで検出され、身体検査は1.5%に過ぎなかった。
summary_en: Systematic review of relapse detection methods in stage I testicular germ cell tumors managed with active surveillance after orchidectomy. Analysis of 2,232 relapses among 11,414 patients shows 60% detected by imaging alone, 24% by tumor markers, and only 1.5% by physical examination, supporting safe AS without mandatory physical examination.

title: Clinicopathological Profile and Obstetric Outcome of Pregnant Women with Persistent Adnexal Masses.
title_ja: 妊娠中の持続性付属器腫瘤の臨床病理学的特徴と産科学的転帰
summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣腫瘤を持つ63人の女性の後向き研究。成熟奇形腫が最も一般的な組織型（32%）。90%が良性であり、保存的管理が可能であることを示唆した。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 63 pregnant women with persistent adnexal masses. Mature teratoma was most common histology (32%), with 90% benign and 10% malignant. Supports conservative management of imaging-benign masses until delivery without adverse feto-maternal outcomes.

title: Managing Coexistent Triad of Ovarian Tumors while Conserving Ovarian Function.
title_ja: 卵巣機能を温存しながら卵巣腫瘍3種の共存に対する管理
summary_ja: 卵巣における3つの異なる腫瘍の同時存在の珍しい症例報告：内膜症性嚢胞、線維腫、および成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。完全摘出と卵巣保存を達成した。
summary_en: Case report of rare coexistence of three distinct ovarian tumors: endometriotic cyst and fibroma in one ovary, and mature cystic teratoma in the other. Combined laparoscopic and laparotomy approach used to completely remove tumors while preserving healthy ovarian tissue.

title: Mature Teratoma with Malignant Brenner Tumour: A Rare Ovarian Collision Tumour Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 悪性Brenner腫瘍を伴う成熟奇形腫：稀な卵巣衝突腫瘍症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫と悪性ブレンナー腫瘍の衝突腫瘍についての症例報告。両方の組織型の正確な診断が管理と予後の決定に重要である。
summary_en: Case report of rare ovarian collision tumor combining mature teratoma with malignant Brenner tumor. Immunohistochemical examination essential for accurate diagnosis of both distinct histological components; diagnosis determines further management and disease prognosis.

title: Immunohistochemical Staining: Prognostic Marker of Malignant Transformation of Hydatidiform Mole (HM).
title_ja: 免疫組織化学染色：胞状奇胎の悪性化の予後マーカー
summary_ja: 水胞状奇胎の悪性転化の予測マーカーとしての免疫組織化学的検査の研究。27例の追跡で、P53過剰発現がGTNへの進行と相関。NM23は正常な退行の高い陰性予測値を示した。
summary_en: Study evaluating immunohistochemical markers (p53, EGFR, HER2, NM23) as prognostic biomarkers for malignant transformation of hydatidiform moles (GTD). Follow-up of 27 molar pregnancies found p53 overexpression correlated with progression to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia; NM23 showed high negative predictive value for normal regression.

title: Additional value of uterine artery Doppler pulsatility index for ultrasound diagnosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor: prospective cohort study.
title_ja: 胎盤部栄養膜腫瘍の超音波診断における子宮動脈ドップラーパルサティリティインデックスの追加的価値：前向きコホート研究
summary_ja: 胎盤部絨毛膜癌（PSTT）の超音波診断評価についての前向きコホート研究。UtA-PIが他のGTN形態と比較してPSTTの鑑別診断に有用なマーカーとなることを示唆した。
summary_en: Prospective cohort study evaluating uterine artery Doppler pulsatility index (UtA-PI) for ultrasound diagnosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a form of GTD. Higher mean UtA-PI and lower endometrial vascularity in PSTT compared to other GTN forms provide novel differential diagnostic markers.

title: Outcomes of Patients With International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group Good Prognosis Metastatic Seminoma Undergoing De-Escalation Chemotherapy: A Single-Center Retrospective Study.
title_ja: 国際胚細胞がん共同研究グループ予後良好転移性セミノーマに対する化学療法減量レジメンの成績：単一施設後向き研究
summary_ja: 国際生殖細胞がん協働グループの低リスク転移性セミノーマ患者における化学療法減量の後向き研究。3サイクルのエトポシド/シスプラチン化学療法で同等の転帰が得られた。
summary_en: Single-center retrospective study of de-escalation chemotherapy (three cycles etoposide/cisplatin) versus standard therapy in IGCCCG good prognosis metastatic seminoma. Comparable survival outcomes with slightly lower adverse event rates in de-escalation group, providing preliminary basis for reduced chemotherapy in selected patients with lower metastatic burden.

title: A Challenging Diagnosis of Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma Arising From Malignant Struma Ovarii.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫から生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌の診断的課題
summary_ja: 甲状腺組織を含む卵巣奇形腫（悪性ストルマ卵巣炎）から生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例報告。TSH抑制療法と長期監視が必要である。
summary_en: Case report of papillary thyroid carcinoma arising from malignant struma ovarii (ovarian teratoma containing thyroid tissue). 46-year-old woman with abdominal pain; surgery revealed struma ovarii with papillary thyroid carcinoma requiring TSH suppression therapy and long-term surveillance.

title: Clinical evaluation of the role of miRNA 371 in small testicular masses. Results of the "S1STeM 371" Trial.
title_ja: 小精巣腫瘤におけるmiRNA 371の役割の臨床評価："S1STeM 371"試験の結果
summary_ja: 小さい精巣腫瘤（5-20mm）におけるGCT予測のための血清マイクロRNA 371の臨床試験。マイクロRNA 371はGCT検出の高い感度と陰性予測値を示し、スクリーニングバイオマーカーとして有用であった。
summary_en: Prospective clinical trial evaluating serum miRNA 371 for predicting germ cell tumors in small testicular masses (5-20 mm). Among 32 patients, 65.6% had GCTs (14 seminomas, 6 non-seminomas, 1 GCNIS). miRNA 371 showed 100% sensitivity and 100% NPV at RQ cutoff 5, supporting use as screening biomarker for small masses.

title: Adenine nucleotide translocase 2 silencing promotes metabolic reprogramming in P19 embryonal carcinoma stem cells.
title_ja: アデニンヌクレオチドトランスロカーゼ2の低下はP19胎児性癌幹細胞の代謝リプログラミングを促進する
journal: Biochim Biophys Acta Mol Basis Dis
summary_ja: P19胚腫細胞株におけるANT2枯渇後の代謝リモデリングを検討。OXPHOS機構と僧帽体機能の障害、細胞増殖と球形成能の低下が認められ、ANT2が癌幹細胞生存の重要な調節因子であることが示唆された。
summary_en: This study examines metabolic reprogramming in P19 embryonal carcinoma stem cells after ANT2 depletion. Results show compromised OXPHOS machinery and mitochondrial dysfunction, with decreased cell growth and sphere-forming ability, identifying ANT2 as a key regulator of cancer stem cell survival.

title: Perioperative morbidity of open retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular germ cell tumors: an in-depth single center analysis according to European Association of Urology guidelines of complication reporting and a scoping literature review.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する開放的後腹膜リンパ節郭清の周術期合併症：ヨーロッパ泌尿器科学会合併症報告ガイドラインに基づいた詳細な単一施設分析とスコーピング文献レビュー
summary_ja: 69人の精巣がん患者における後腹膜リンパ節郭清術の周術期合併症を標準化EAUガイドラインで分析。患者の96%が合併症を経験し、貧血とGI障害が最も一般的。重大合併症は稀だが罹病負担は重大であった。
summary_en: This single-center study analyzes perioperative complications of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 69 testicular cancer patients using standardized EAU reporting guidelines. Most patients experienced complications (96%), with anemia and gastrointestinal issues most common; major complications were rare but morbidity burden was significant.

title: Rare scenarios in germ cell tumors: A case series.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における稀な臨床シナリオ：症例集積
summary_ja: 生殖細胞腫瘍の稀な臨床例を報告。原発性縦隔GCT、消化管浸潤、骨転移、心臓血栓症、および高齢者におけるセルトリ・ライディヒ細胞腫瘍が含まれ、診断と管理の課題が強調されている。
summary_en: This case series presents unusual presentations of germ cell tumors including primary mediastinal GCT with hemophagocytosis, gastrointestinal involvement, bone metastases, cardiac thrombosis, and a rare Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor in an elderly patient, highlighting diagnostic and management challenges.

title: Ovarian teratoma leading to colonic intussusception: a case report.
title_ja: 結腸腸重積をきたした卵巣奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 40歳女性における卵巣成熟奇形腫による結腸内陥症と閉塞の症例。腹腔鏡下に奇形腫が原因であることが判明し、結腸部分切除と卵巣摘出術が施行され、良好な術後経過を認めた。
summary_en: This case reports colonic intussusception and obstruction caused by a mature ovarian teratoma invading the colon in a 40-year-old female. Laparoscopic exploration revealed the teratoma as the cause, requiring partial colectomy and oophorectomy with good postoperative recovery.

title: Robot-assisted laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in testicular cancer using a single-position supine approach: A case report and literature review.
title_ja: ロボット支援腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清：単一体位仰臥位アプローチを用いた精巣がん症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣生殖細胞腫瘍とケモ後残存腫瘍に対する単一体位仰臥位ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清術の症例報告。より侵襲の少ない効率的なアプローチを提供している。
summary_en: This case report describes a single-position supine robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection technique for nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors and post-chemotherapy residual masses in a 33-year-old patient, offering a less invasive and more efficient approach.

title: Intradural-Intramedullary Spinal Teratoma with Syrinx Formation: A Case Report.
title_ja: 脊髄空洞形成を伴う硬膜内髄内脊髄奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 6歳児の髄内奇形腫で、尿および便症状で発症。CT/MRIは嚢胞性固形成分とシリンクス形成を示した。手術で完全切除を実現し、良好な経過を得た。早期診断の重要性が強調された。
summary_en: This case describes an intradural-intramedullary teratoma in a 6-year-old child presenting with urinary and fecal symptoms. CT and MRI showed cystic and solid components with syrinx formation. Surgical resection achieved total removal with good outcome.

title: Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma Arising in Struma Ovarii With Subsequent Thyroid Microcarcinoma: A Case Report and Review of the Literature.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌と続く甲状腺微小癌：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 43歳女性のストルマオバリイ（単層性卵巣奇形腫）から生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例。3年後の甲状腺微小癌診断と、転移性疾患と同期性原発腫瘍の鑑別課題が論じられた。
summary_en: This case describes papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in struma ovarii (monodermal ovarian teratoma) in a 43-year-old woman, with subsequent thyroid microcarcinoma diagnosis 3 years later. Diagnostic challenges in distinguishing metastatic disease from primary tumors are discussed.

title: Intestinal Metastasis of Choriocarcinoma: A Case Report of a Rare Cause of Gastrointestinal Bleeding.
title_ja: 絨毛癌の腸転移：消化管出血の稀な原因の症例報告
summary_ja: 流産後の妊娠性絨毛癌の腸転移による消化管出血の症例。hCGレベル（>1,000,000 IU/mL）が著しく上昇し、転移性疾患が確認された。多発転移と周術期合併症により患者は死亡した。
summary_en: This case reports intestinal metastasis of gestational choriocarcinoma in a 30-year-old patient with gastrointestinal bleeding following molar pregnancy. Extremely elevated hCG levels (>1,000,000 IU/mL) and imaging confirmed metastatic disease. Complications led to patient death despite chemotherapy.

title: Atypical Radiological Presentation of a Neonatal Primary Retroperitoneal Teratoma Undergoing Haemorrhagic Evolution: A Case Report.
title_ja: 出血性進化を呈した新生児原発性後腹膜奇形腫の非典型的放射線学的所見：症例報告
summary_ja: 15日齢の新生児における原発性後腹膜奇形腫の症例。腹部膨隆と発熱で発症し、出生前超音波で嚢胞性病変を検出。固形成分と石灰化を伴って進化。手術で出血梗塞の確認を得た。
summary_en: This case describes a primary retroperitoneal teratoma in a 15-day-old neonate presenting with abdominal distension and fever. Prenatal ultrasound detected a cystic lesion that evolved to show solid components and calcifications. Surgical excision confirmed hemorrhagic infarction.

title: A Rare Case of Mixed Malignant Ovarian Germ Cell Tumor Composed of Immature Teratoma and Yolk Sac Tumor.
title_ja: 未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍からなる稀な悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍症例
summary_ja: 23歳女性における卵巣混合生殖細胞腫瘍（不成熟奇形腫60%、ヨーク嚢腫40%）の症例。広範な転移を伴い、手術とBEP化学療法にもかかわらず奏効率が低く、臨床試験が検討された。
summary_en: This case report describes a mixed malignant ovarian germ cell tumor in a 23-year-old woman containing immature teratoma (60%) and yolk sac tumor (40%) with extensive metastases. Despite surgery and BEP chemotherapy, poor response was noted.

title: Immunotherapy in young adults with mature cystic ovarian Teratoma-Derived squamous cell carcinoma: a case series.
title_ja: 若年成人における成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫由来扁平上皮癌に対する免疫療法：症例集積
summary_ja: 25歳女性2例における成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌（FIGO分類IIIA1、IC2）。妊孕性温存手術とBEP化学療法+PD-1阻害剤で完全寛解を達成した。
summary_en: This case series reports squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratomas in two 25-year-old women (FIGO stage IIIA1 and IC2). Both underwent fertility-sparing surgery and received chemotherapy combined with PD-1 inhibitor immunotherapy, achieving complete response.

title: CircRNA-NOLC1 mediates Insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor via performing as a ceRNA of miRNA-140-5p to facilitate testicular germ cell tumor advancement.
title_ja: CircRNA-NOLC1はmiRNA-140-5pのセスポンジとして作用することによりインスリン様成長因子1受容体を媒介し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進行を促進する
summary_ja: circNOLC1の精巣生殖細胞腫瘍進行における役割を調査。circNOLC1上昇はリンパ節転移と臨床病期に相関。circNOLC1はmiRNA-140-5pスポンジとして機能し、IGF1R発現を上昇させ、腫瘍細胞の増殖と浸潤を促進する。
summary_en: This study investigates circNOLC1's role in testicular germ cell tumor progression using TGCT tissues and cell lines. Elevated circNOLC1 correlates with lymph node metastasis and clinical stage. CircNOLC1 acts as miRNA-140-5p sponge to upregulate IGF1R, promoting TGCT progression.

title: Second malignancies in long-term testicular cancer survivors.
title_ja: 精巣癌長期生存者における二次悪性腫瘍
summary_ja: 1,367名の精巣癌患者（セミノーマを含む）の長期追跡調査により二次悪性腫瘍の発生を分析。セミノーマ患者で精巣癌の再発が特に高率。前立腺癌と腎癌は一般人口より若い年齢で発症。放射線療法と化学療法が二次悪性腫瘍の発生に関連。胚細胞腫瘍生存者の長期管理に重要。
summary_en: This long-term follow-up study of 1,367 testicular cancer patients examines second malignancy occurrence between 1970 and 2012. Seminoma survivors showed particularly high recurrence of testicular cancer. Results demonstrated increased rates of prostate and kidney cancer developing in younger ages than the general population. Second malignancy incidence was strongly correlated with treatment modality, particularly radiotherapy and chemotherapy, making this data important for managing long-term GCT survivors.

title: Adult immunohistochemical markers fail to detect intratubular germ cell neoplasia in prepubertal boys with cryptorchidism.
title_ja: 停留精巣を有する前思春期男児における成人型免疫組織化学マーカーは精細管内胚細胞新生物の検出に失敗する
summary_ja: 停留精巣を有する前思春期男児における精細管内胚細胞新生物の検出を目指して、成人型免疫組織化学マーカー（PLAP、Oct3/4、C-kit、D2-40）の有用性を検討。236個の精巣生検標本を調査した結果、成人標準マーカーは若年者では偽陽性率が高く、通常の矯正手術年齢でのITGCNスクリーニングには不適切であることが判明。
summary_en: This study systematically evaluates immunohistochemical markers for detecting intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN), a precursor to testicular germ cell cancer in prepubertal boys with cryptorchidism. Testing 236 testicular biopsies from 170 boys, the authors found that adult-standard placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and Oct3/4 markers show high false-positive rates in young children, significantly limiting their diagnostic utility for ITGCN screening before typical orchiopexy age.

title: Pre-existing morbidity pattern in a Danish testicular cancer cohort: insights beyond the testicular dysgenesis syndrome hypothesis.
title_ja: デンマーク精巣癌コホートにおける既往疾患パターン: 精巣ディスジェネシス症候群仮説を超えた知見
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者1,952例と対照19,431例のデンマーク登録研究。TC患者は診断前に複数の健康領域で周術期疾患の有意に高いリスクを示し、精巣形成異常症候群仮説に異議を唱えた。
summary_en: This Danish registry-based cohort study of 1,952 testicular cancer patients and 19,431 controls found TC patients had significantly higher pre-existing morbidity across multiple health domains, challenging conventional hypotheses and highlighting broader health burden prior to diagnosis.

title: Hyperthyroidism Associated with Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia: Systematic Literature Review and Pathways Analysis.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に関連する甲状腺機能亢進症: システマティックレビューとパスウェイ解析
summary_ja: 妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍に関連する甲状腺機能亢進症のシステマティックレビュー。32例の絨毛癌と1例のPSTTを特定。甲状腺機能障害はhCG仲介TSH交差反応と甲状腺ホルモン結合グロブリン効果を含む複数の経路で生じる。
summary_en: This systematic review examines hyperthyroidism in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, identifying 32 choriocarcinomas and one PSTT. Thyroid dysfunction occurs via multiple pathways including hCG-mediated TSH cross-reactivity. Symptoms typically resolve within 2-3 weeks after treatment.
